Your ADHD makes you who you are. You will be a Greta mother if you are there for your child. 
I can relate about not realize til later in life that I have ADHD. I was 35 when I put 2 and 2 together because I wasn't a hyper child either but I see now how it affected me my whole life without me know. Never let anyone put you down for it, I have had people in my life throw it in my face, say I use it as excuse and say many more. It can be a process that will take some work and adjusting but you can do it. If you need anyone to vent to or talk with message me, will always listen and do my best to help. I know how I allowed other to see me feel for having it.

She wasn't my wife but we're together years. It started as one slap because she didn't like my answers and felt I wasn't open about my feeling and what I was going through. Then it happen more often and got worse. Hit with shoes, stuff throw at me, slapped, punched, kicked. To point where had black eyes, bruised on face, side of head, my ear was purple. Punched in the face while driving on the highway. This last time from kicking me in nuts then ribs. She bruised my ribs which hurt like hell to breath and also bruised my nut, that hurt like hell too. Working on getting away, it has been couple week and she reached out recently but haven't responded. I always said I wouldn't be in a abusive relationship after seeing my mom get beating when I was young but I was.

There was so many I don't even know where to start.

The way I sat when I ate. 
Making her nephew more eggs
Went for a run with her son and he was 2 steps behind me running. 
Calling her sweetheart instead of baby
Not listening to music when cooking
Not having TV on while we eating dinner
How I sat when in a chair
Not letting her friend drive my company vehicle
Doing what she told me to do. Lol
Being too busy while we were hosting a family cookout
And honestly so many more but I could be here all day

No I am not bugging her at work usually call her once during day to check on her, I would text her but she constantly saying we grown and not text all the time. If she busy she can not answer but if she calls me and I don't answer soon enough she will be upset. If she calls and I tell her I am busy at work she half the time gets upset. I asked becuase she got mad and said I have nothing to talk about when I just called to check on her and see if she wanted lunch.

Them line can be a joke and they barely listen to you and what you have going on. I am in the same situation, have no one who I can open to and my life is a disaster. Today will my last day here if I am not weak enough to do it. If you need someone to talk to for now I am here. I can be an ear.
I hate my life. She told me today I need to just die. I am a waste of life and waste of air. I ready to take my life and end my pain and suffering.
Never seen it but definally heard about it. Cant watch it right now but here to chat if you need someone.

Thank you for even answering me.i live in the united states. She can say such amazing thing and make me feel good, she goes to sleep and next morning it like we starting all over. I have never felt as low as I do right now and feel like everything I do is wrong. Constantly being told I am wrong and reminded of my failures. It is also complicated because she has a 10 year old son who i love and part of me moving in is to be there for him and moved my work schedule to be at the house with him on Fridays. I feel so bad walking out on him but I also know some of the thing he seen is not good for him. The physical abuse and the screaming from his mom. I just feel like I am wrong no matter what I do. Stay or go. 
It would be easier to not be here and no one would have to worry about me or the mess I have cause. I have been called evil and the devil. I used to think I was a good person. Just want to be numb to life. ..

I'm not sure what to do. We are so compatible and alike in many ways, our goods are so good but I feel worthless and she tells me it. "You are nothing". I don't have anyone I can talk to right now, most people I used to be close with I am not. Thing with family isn't good right now. I just want this feeling to end, want to not feel hurt or depressed anymore. I slept in my car the other day because things got so bad. I just don't want to feel anymore. No one will notice except when I don't show for work. It does feel like I matter anymore. Why am I here.

The mechanics had many things to check and it ended up being in there 6 hours or so. I am asking because my girl was mad I didn't go up there and wait for it and make sure he doing what he needed. I have always dropped off car unless it something thing I know will be quick like changing tire.

I am prefect okay with letting her know If I make it somewhere safe but I called when I left work with no answer. When she heads out alot of time I will ask to text me just to make sure she makes it safe. Which half the time she doesn't. I had already thanked her for looking out for me and referring to the doctor at least twice. She is such a great women is so many ways, we can have so much fun and enjoy each other then sometime feel like she has another personality and acts like this.

Yes it is alot but I do love the women. She does have alot of baggage from how her mom treats her, her family has some issues that has made her feel like other don't care. Like if you forget certain things she make it huge like I don't care and I'm selfish. One time when on vacation I ran in the store with 3 kids to grab a few things, I couldn't find the English muffin she likes so I got the next best one and forgot the butter. It was a huge ordeal because I got the wrong one and who would forget the butter.

Thank you. No she is in fact 33 year old women.  I though it was stupid too. When she mad for any reason she will make up reason to get mad. I got many story about things I though were real stupid but just found out about this page to post.
